user_prompt: We need to track a equipment modification we're rolling out next month and manage the related service requests from our field teams. Can you help me set up the workflow to document this change and keep everyone updated on the status?

steps.step_name: We need to track a equipment modification we're rolling out next month and manage the related service requests from our field teams. Can you help me set up the workflow to document this change and keep everyone updated on the status?

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
- corp.itsm: Internal IT service management (incident analysis, asset provisioning, safety incidents)
  - AssetProvisioningOrchestrator: Automates IT asset lifecycle from engineering changes
  - ChangeAutomationOrchestrator: General orchestrator for engineering changes & material provisioning (PRIMARY for change tracking & workflow management)
  - IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer: Analyzes service tickets, correlates incident patterns, suggests preventive actions
  - IncidentSafetyCoordinator: Safety incident detection & response workflows
- sap.ariba: Procurement/supply chain
  - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI: PO lifecycle, supplier collaboration, real-time status tracking
  - VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation: Invoice matching to POs & contracts
  - SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor: Vendor risk management, hazardous materials tracking
  - MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator: Coordinates material updates & engineering changes
- sap.crm: Sales/marketing (opportunities, campaigns, compensation)
- sap.odm: Entity type taxonomy (40 canonical business objects)
- emarsys.cx: Customer experience/engagement
- workday.hcm: HR/HCM system
- sap.ehs: Safety/EHS with SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator
- siemens.plm: PLM with EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning agent, BOM validation
  - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator: Material approval & supplier assessment
- sap.s4: ERP with cost/procurement focus
  - ProcurementMatchingAgent: Vendor cost analysis, pricing comparison, performance metrics
  - BOMComplianceAutomationAgent: BOM validation, supplier compliance verification
  - AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator: Engineering change coordination
  - OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine: Sales opportunity to order conversion
- my.mes: Manufacturing execution
  - ProductionChangeOrchestrator: Coordinates synchronized updates across production workflows

KEY PATTERNS:
- **Equipment/engineering change tracking + service request management → corp.itsm:ChangeAutomationOrchestrator** (automates & coordinates changes, synchronizes updates, tracks status across ITSM ecosystem)
- BOM spend analysis + compliance + risk → sap.s4:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent
- Product cost analysis & supplier benchmarking → sap.s4:ProcurementMatchingAgent
- Supply chain partner visibility & purchase commitments → sap.ariba:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI
- IT infrastructure automation from engineering changes → corp.itsm:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator
- Manufacturing workflow synchronization → my.mes:ProductionChangeOrchestrator

args.reason: Automates and coordinates engineering changes with automated workflows, synchronizes updates across material and product configurations, and provides consistent change orchestration for tracking equipment modifications and managing service request status.
